create_reranker_instance: create a Reranker instance from a checkpoint and config to rerank retrieved passages
run_reranker: run the Reranker to score and re-rank retrieved passages by relevance
get_queries_data: get queries data by transforming retrieved results into DPR schema format
set_queries_data: set preprocessed query-context pairs for the Reranker to process
get_ctxt_encoder_input_in_dpr_schema: get context encoder input in DPR schema from multiple retriever outputs and gold queries
